_meta.name: RPG Your Way SRD 5.2.1 Creature Catalog v2
_meta.purpose: Compact local AIGM creature-selection index. General creatures contain name, CR, and natural habitat tags. Humanoids retain HP and RPG Your Way NPC-use metadata for bystanders and scene population.

notes: npc_use and incidental_npc are RPG Your Way metadata, not SRD classifications.
Narrative occupation may reuse an appropriate Humanoid stat block; for example, a dockworker can use Commoner statistics.
SRD swarm stat blocks are grouped under Beast or Undead so the catalog uses the 14 standard creature types.
Habitat is intentionally compact. Empty habitat arrays are valid and do not mean the creature cannot appear elsewhere.

incidental_npc_values.preferred: Good default for ordinary scene population or bystanders.
incidental_npc_values.situational: Useful for a particular role or scene, but not a default civilian.
incidental_npc_values.not_incidental: Too specialized, powerful, or narratively significant for routine bystander use.

_meta.habitat_source: 2024 Free Basic Rules / Monsters by Habitat tables. Habitat arrays are natural-habitat suggestions; an empty array means no natural habitat was listed there, commonly for extraplanar or specially placed creatures.
